patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Carepatron and Gusto share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Carepatron and Gusto share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Carepatron only if your buying job matches “Healthcare practice management software — affiliate partner in HR / people operations.” rather than Gusto's shape. Choose Gusto only if your buying job matches “US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Pre” rather than Carepatron's shape. Workflow advantage: Carepatron leans people-platform; Gusto leans payroll-benefits. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Carepatron and Gusto share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Carepatron is Healthcare practice management software — affiliate partner in HR / people operations.; Gusto is US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 + $12; Premium $180 + $22..
- Workflow coverage skew: Carepatron-leaning people-platform vs Gusto-leaning payroll-benefits.
- Researched limits: Carepatron — Healthcare practice scope — not general HRIS; Gusto — Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus.

Limitations — Carepatron: Healthcare practice scope — not general HRIS; Gusto: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus; People/HRIS depth is light versus BambooHR; Gusto is payroll-first.

Poor-fit cases: Carepatron is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Healthcare practice scope — not general HRIS · Gusto is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Simple plan is single-state payroll — multi-state needs Plus · Avoid Carepatron if you actually need Gusto's motion (US SMB payroll + benefits + light HR — Simple from $49/mo + $6/person; Plus $80 )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
